entry.title: welcome to .noise.
entry.content:
Mabuhay! This is .noise., the part of my website for things that don’t fit in a paper.

Expect a mix of:

  • research ☁️🌧️🌨️❄️: Arctic clouds, climate models, and life as a PhD student in Göteborg
  • freediving 🤿: time spent in (and under) the ocean
  • films 🍿: what I’ve been watching
  • photography 📷: how I see the world
  • random ❓: anything under the sun

Thanks for stopping by.
entry.summary: A small corner of this site for everything that isn't a paper.
